title: Dev10 checkpoint — complete canonical evidence identity
summary: Dev10 repairs a dev9 canonical serialization integrity gap: scopes, knowledge cutoffs, superseded records and full conflict/retraction histories now participate in sorted length-prefixed evidence materialisation. ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 passed 129 native checks across ten positive suites and 13 expected-negative cases, including 14 new closure assertions. The complete pinned source is delivered as a ZIP; GitHub source remains incremental; Gopher catalogue activation has not been confirmed.
invariants: Canonical format is LIBRARIAN-PROVENANCE-SNAPSHOT/2; never compare with dev9 canonical values as though they have identical schemas.
Serialization is not a cryptographic digest or authenticity proof; it records query and materialised evidence, not original-media capture verification.
Time Service v0.3 is the pinned tested conversion provider. Upstream v0.9 requires a separate compatibility qualification.
Historical corrections, competing forks, retractions and knowledge cutoffs remain in the identity; permutation of independent evidence does not affect it.
No source-independence certification, editorial-bias verdict, causal Brand Effect or CMS publishing authority.
Alchemy Gopher sphere checker currently has not resolved librarian-v2: GitHub publication alone is not sphere deployment.
